description:
Gideon here, an Electrical and Electronics Engineering student into embedded systems and TinyML. I do debate, so I can lead our pitch.
Our project, CODE-BLUE, warns the crew when an astronaut's health looks wrong, using Edge Impulse and a simple dashboard.
Join us if you want: a beginner-friendly team, and a project for your portfolio.
We need: a web or dashboard builder, a Python and data helper, a designer or storyteller, and anyone with health knowledge.
Beginners are welcome. Message me!
